mapper.sql: m.MAP_ID AS "mapId", m.SRC_TEXT AS "sourceText", m.CODE_GRP_ID AS "groupId", m.CODE AS "code", c.CODE_NM AS "codeName", m.REG_USER_ID AS "regUserId", m.REG_DTTM AS "regDttm", m.MOD_USER_ID AS "modUserId", m.MOD_DTTM AS "modDttm"
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM TB_SY_CODE_MAP m JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID=m.CODE_GRP_ID AND c.CODE=m.CODE
SELECT c.CODE_NM FROM TB_SY_CODE c JOIN TB_SY_CODE_GRP g ON g.CODE_GRP_ID=c.CODE_GRP_ID WHERE c.CODE_GRP_ID=#{groupId} AND c.CODE=#{code} AND c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N' FOR SHARE OF c, g

INSERT INTO TB_SY_CODE_MAP (SRC_TEXT, CODE_GRP_ID, CODE, REG_USER_ID, REG_DTTM) VALUES (#{sourceText}, #{groupId}, #{code}, #{userId}, #{occurredAt}) ON CONFLICT (SRC_TEXT,CODE_GRP_ID) DO NOTHING RETURNING MAP_ID
SELECT FROM TB_SY_CODE_MAP m JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID=m.CODE_GRP_ID AND c.CODE=m.CODE WHERE m.MAP_ID=#{mapId} FOR UPDATE OF m
